name: Taxonomy Bulk Actions
description: Enhence taxonomy term listing with bulk actions functionnality like Delete, publish and unpublish multiple terms
project_description:
Taxonomy Bulk Actions module enhance Drupal default taxonomy terms listing with a powerful extensible bulk action system based on the new TaxonomyBulkActionsManager plugin type.

 By default The module provides some default actions such as delete multiple taxonomy terms and publish/unpublish multiple taxonomy terms

 
 
You could add your own custom taxonomy action using TaxonomyBulkActionsManager plugin type. For more details, you could visit Add custom taxonomy bulk actions documentation page.
 

 
 Are you facing a bug with this module ? 
 
 Please don't hesitate to check Taxonomy Bulk Actions issues queue page and open a new issue there when necessary.
